InfoPage.title: About Keystroke Symphony
InfoPage.description: An advanced typing trainer designed to elevate your keyboard skills through practice and play.
features: Practice with different keyboard layouts: QWERTY, DVORAK, and AZERTY.
Generate unique typing tests every time with random text generation.
Track your Words Per Minute (WPM) and accuracy.
Get customized exercises based on your performance with AI-Powered Personalized Training.
Adjust the challenge to match your skill level with various difficulty levels.
See where you made mistakes with real-time accuracy feedback.
Learn proper finger placement with finger-to-key mapping visualization.
Practice with your own text using the custom text input feature.
Play an engaging 'Falling Words' game to make practice fun.
InfoPage.gettingStarted: Navigate to the <practiceLink>Practice</practiceLink> page to start a standard typing test, or try the <gameLink>Game</gameLink> mode for a more interactive experience.
InfoPage.gameStrategy: In 'Falling Words' mode, your goal is to type the words as they descend down the screen before they reach the bottom. Each correctly typed word disappears and adds to your score. If a word reaches the bottom, you lose health. The game ends when your health reaches zero. Build up a combo by typing words correctly in a row to activate a score multiplier. The game's speed and the number of words will increase as you score more points, so stay focused!
